product.name: A-Star 32U4 Robot Controller LV with Raspberry Pi Bridge (SMT Components Only)

warnings: The 65 x 56 mm outline comes from the supplied data, which is flagged as unverified. The four corner holes are visible in the images. Their 2.75 mm diameter and their positions (3.5 mm in from each edge, 58 x 49 mm spacing) come from the Raspberry Pi HAT specification, which the product says it conforms to, and were not measured from the images. The 1.6 mm thickness is an assumed typical PCB thickness, because height is null in the data. Components such as the electrolytic capacitor rise above this and are not included in the z bound. The many small prototyping holes were not modeled, because their count and diameter are not given. The board corners look rounded, but the radius is not stated.
The 65 x 56 mm outline comes from unverified supplied data.
The 1.6 mm thickness is assumed, since no height was given.
The four mounting hole positions and 2.75 mm diameter come from the Raspberry Pi HAT specification, not from measurement.
The corners look rounded, but the radius is unknown, so they are left square.
The prototyping hole grid and SMT components (microcontroller, capacitor, regulator, switches, USB connector, LEDs) are omitted because their sizes and counts are uncertain.
Silkscreen and labels are not modeled.
